subject: tip ranges same order as tree?

messages.author: e6ac6506bddc9816
messages.subject: tip ranges same order as tree?
parts:
Hello,

I have a quick question. Must the species in the tip ranges object be in the same order as listed in the phylogeny for everything to work correctly? I am running a DEC model in BioGeoBEARS. I know the function "order_tipranges_by_tree_tips" exists for this purpose, but it's not clear to me if this is a requirement or not (I have already started running my analysis).

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] tip ranges same order as tree?
parts:
On Mon, Sep 4, 2017 at 2:29 AM, <lizmil...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello,

I have a quick question. Must the species in the tip ranges object be in the same order as listed in the phylogeny for everything to work correctly? I am running a DEC model in BioGeoBEARS. I know the function "order_tipranges_by_tree_tips" exists for this purpose, but it's not clear to me if this is a requirement or not (I have already started running my analysis).

Hi -- no, this is not a requirement.  I don't remember exactly, but probably I use "order_tipranges_by_tree_tips" internally to get the geog-file data into the right order for the storage of the downpass likelihoods.

So, don't worry about this.  The areas should be in the same order in the geog file, and in the distances matrix, the connectivity matrix, etc., if you use those.  There is an error check that should give an error message if they don't line up, though.

Cheers!
nick
